title: Need to recover 2 yrs of emails after fresh install of Ubuntu
creator: netsurfau
content:
Due to issues with upgrading from Ubuntu 24.04.1 to 26.04.1, I decided to just start from scratch with a new clean install.

After finalising the install, I copied across my Thunderbird data to the new partition, merging directories as the data copied across. But, somewhere in the transfer I lost about the last two years emails, with only emails up until 12/24 being available.

There are a lot a important emails I need to recover, and I'm guessing they're still on my PC, in the old partition, and I desperately need help to recover them.

title: da ieri non funziona "allegare Documenti" su mio Mac

content: Ho controllato adesso sulle fonti ufficiali di Thunderbird. La cosa molto interessante è questa: la tua 153.4.0esr è uscita ieri, 30 settembre 2026.
